lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the pectoral fin base, characterized by vertical columns of 3 to 4 primary nodes across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the vertical axes of the primary spots, creating a rectangular grid-like pattern across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the most prominent displays a sharp transition from high-intensity light on the dorsal edge to deep shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense population of smaller, lower-intensity spots localized on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin compared to the larger macro-spots on the main lateral flank.
